comment: Frozen oracle bundle for the native hooks-render port (GO-20 U2e T5 PR2-B S8). Captured once from the live Python 3.14.7 oracle (testdata/hooksrender_ref.py driving lib/_internal/hooks-render.py) through the same in-package helpers the live differential used. Frozen properties: rc, stdout, the written tree+modes and stderr. For the traceback records (exc_marker set) Python stderr is an uncaught traceback embedding host paths, so it is DROPPED and only the exception-type marker is frozen, exactly the containment check the live test made. Each dropped stderr was verified to contain a host path. Restore from a pristine copy, never re-encode.
